title: 阻止App Service槽交换把生产连接字符串切到预发布
source: 独立编审：Azure特定配置根因
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

conversion.original_title: App Service槽交换后生产代码连接到预发布数据库，连接字符串未标为正确slot setting。如何桌面处置？

body:
## 操作任务
实现只读inspect_swap(production,staging,required_connection_strings)：解析两个App Service槽位的配置JSON，针对每个必须环境隔离的连接字符串，要求其在两个槽都存在、类型一致且slotSetting=true；缺失或不粘性时阻止交换并给出字段级原因。不得修改输入，不做Azure API调用。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
真实Python子进程解析隔离槽位配置；检查安全配置、非粘性故障、缺项和类型错配。

## 能力边界
临时本地JSON配置的离线合同验证；复现生产/预发布连接字符串未同时设置slotSetting的风险，并验证安全配置、缺项、类型不一致边界。只模拟部署槽配置语义，不证明Azure资源已更新或生产连接已恢复。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,tempfile,json,sys
spec_path=pathlib.Path('task.py');import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',spec_path);task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True);print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: inspect deployment slot swap safety',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 root=pathlib.Path(td)
 def save(name,items):
  p=root/name;p.write_text(json.dumps({"properties":{"connectionStrings":items}}),encoding="utf8");return p
 prod=save('prod.json',[{"name":"MainDb","type":"SQLAzure","value":"Server=prod","slotSetting":True},{"name":"Cache","type":"Custom","value":"prod-cache","slotSetting":True}])
 stage=save('stage.json',[{"name":"MainDb","type":"SQLAzure","value":"Server=preprod","slotSetting":True},{"name":"Cache","type":"Custom","value":"stage-cache","slotSetting":True}])
 good=task.inspect_swap(prod,stage,['MainDb']);assert good['safe'] and good['checked']==['MainDb']
 badstage=save('badstage.json',[{"name":"MainDb","type":"SQLAzure","value":"Server=preprod","slotSetting":False}])
 bad=task.inspect_swap(prod,badstage,['MainDb']);assert not bad['safe'] and bad['issues'][0]['reason']=='not_sticky_in_both_slots'
 missing=save('missing.json',[]);assert task.inspect_swap(prod,missing,['MainDb'])['issues'][0]['reason']=='missing_from_one_slot'
 wrong=save('wrong.json',[{"name":"MainDb","type":"Custom","value":"Server=preprod","slotSetting":True}]);assert task.inspect_swap(prod,wrong,['MainDb'])['issues'][0]['reason']=='type_mismatch'

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
